study.question: Observed: g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer click AUC0.668526868 exceeds the aggregate bridge0.668457308 by only0.000069560 at the same32192421 parameters; the blocked placement gain is0.000013262. Does replacing each task-projected occupied-block marginal by a symmetric mean/variance surrogate retain or improve this small benefit, and does auxiliary adapter-context transfer interact with the replacement?
study.hypothesis: The empirical mean of tanh on signed block projections may depend mostly on projected location/dispersion rather than the exact skewed block distribution. Symmetric two-point quadrature can remove unstable higher-order shape while preserving per-coordinate mean/variance above the1e-12 variance floor, potentially improving full-validation click AUC. A transfer-by-summary factorial distinguishes a replacement effect from an auxiliary-context interaction. This is a provisional implementation hypothesis, not established complementarity or novelty.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary lines250-294: target relevance weighted sum without softmax motivates retaining inherited signed intensity; our local block-distribution replacement uses task-specific history/context products and four tasks, not an exact DIN reproduction.

Read pinned benchmark lines221-301: nonlinear sequence encoding precedes query decoding/boosting. We reuse one existing per-task linear projection and replace its empirical tanh average by per-coordinate two-point quadrature; no self-attention/decoder stack. This benchmark source is not original-author equivalence or priority verification.

Read pinned lines113-159: target pooled features tokenize with task tokens before interaction. Our unchanged task adapters use a fixed compressed history distribution, without field tokenization or new task tokens.
Read pinned lines245-274: adjacent group Q/K/V attention then concatenated FFN. We retain existing ten groups and learn no new local encoder; only their projected marginal summary changes.
Read pinned lines175-200: flatten all item history into combined tokenization. We do not flatten into a new tokenizer or import paired streams. No original-method novelty claim is verified.

inherited_components: Entire g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer embedding/scorer/tower/task-residual architecture and its source-confirmed CONFIG
Frozen masked uniform/feedback compression with ten blocks, count-weighted signed base, target-match/local ordinal/coarse linear/quadratic/duplicate detail paths
Existing context_queries/history_projections/interaction_outputs, zero output initialization, product and RMS normalization

study.proposed_difference: Only the summary inside _context_history_correction changes. With M occupied blocks form z_j=W[M*b_j,r] using the inherited task projection and global details r. Compute masked FP32 population mu and variance v of z_j. Empirical summary=mean tanh(z_j); replacement=(tanh(mu+sqrt(v))+tanh(mu-sqrt(v)))/2, with deviation0 when v<=1e-12 and empty summary0. Both compute in every cell, unused outputs retain algebraic-zero edges. No new learned parameter, random draw, current-label input, loss hook, normalization buffer or detached moment. Cross block_distribution with block_aux_adapter_context_grad. Per-coordinate moment matching is approximate only under the declared tiny variance floor; no removal of cross-coordinate covariance can be claimed because inherited tanh/averaging is coordinatewise. The symmetric two-point rule is an elementary moment surrogate; no original quadrature, moment-pooling or architecture-priority claim is made.
predictions: At fixed common nonzero output weights, empty/singleton/homogeneous projected supports recover empirical summaries; arbitrary occupied-block permutations preserve both with global details held fixed. Two occupied points match exactly in real arithmetic above the floor.

Same projected mean/variance but different skew/higher moments produce identical two-point summaries while empirical tanh means can differ; same mean but different variance can still change the two-point summary. This distinguishes the replacement from aggregate pooling.

Working directional prediction: moment_transfer click AUC exceeds empirical_transfer_bridge, with a larger advantage than moment_blocked over empirical_blocked_bridge if higher-order noise interacts with context transfer. Null or opposite signs remain reportable; no numerical gain is assumed.

All cells have identical expected total/embedding/dense parameter counts32192421/31793216/399205; actual wall/GPU/memory/inference cost must be measured. Work matching is a diagnostic and supplies no deployment speed claim.
falsifiers: If the moment surrogate consistently loses to the paired empirical cell, a useful higher-order-discarding replacement is unsupported; this does not establish what specific higher moment mattered.

No click improvement over full empirical transfer falsifies the practical improvement hypothesis for this implementation. Equality alone does not prove moment sufficiency; use paired uncertainty and a separately justified equivalence margin in a later frozen study.
An absent or opposite difference-in-differences leaves the predicted transfer interaction unsupported. A single-seed sign cannot establish a mechanism or significance.
Any masking, gradient-ownership, state/RNG, source/config or reference-parity failure invalidates the contrast before predictive interpretation. Hard-budget exhaustion is not success.
alternative_explanations: Small one-seed differences may reflect optimizer trajectory, BF16 reductions, validation selection across many rounds or seed noise; no cluster bootstrap or repeated seed evidence is present.

A different differentiable distribution summary changes gradient weighting as well as forward information; shared-weight diagnostics distinguish functional behavior but do not prove training-causal moment sufficiency.

Moment variance-floor clipping, saturation, global-detail shifts and repeated projected values can explain effects; log near-floor rates and activation saturation if host diagnostic interface permits. Do not interpret zero-initialized outputs as trained parity.
All auxiliary tasks improve relative to compressed source bests but remain below baseline-din AUCs0.849070/0.864897/0.870182; click-centric gains are not overall task superiority.

Earlier compressed_task0.659194 lost to both sources; context retrieval0.668351, content keys0.667914 and target keys0.667988 failed to exceed aggregate transfer0.668457. More expressive selection has not guaranteed better click quality. r0023 concerns support-normalization moment gradients, not the block marginal mechanism proposed here.
